title: Cozy Cole's lessons at the Krupa-Cole drum school
summary: He took lessons for about four months with Cozy Cole at the Gene Krupa and Cozy Cole school on Eighth Avenue and learned rudiments.

venues.name: Gene Krupa and Cozy Cole drum school

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Beautiful. I know a friend of yours that we didn't mention, whose should come up on here. Cozy Cole, his name came up a little while ago.

Yes, he is. But Cozy, you know, I took lessons from Cozy, when I was learning how to read, I went to Cozy, when he had a was out of school, because he was on 54th Street and 8th Avenue, and I took lessons from him for about 4 months.

Now Cozy was responsible for me getting interested in learning about rudiments, because I didn't know anything about rudiments -- I didn't know a five stroke from a seven stroke rudiment, and a rose was a rose to me, you know?

Yeah. I'm glad his name came up when we were talking about young drummers, because you said you went to him and he's always been around to kind of lend a hand to young people in the drumming business.
Oh, yes. Well, he helped me a lot as far as the technical part of drumming goes -- he was a great help to me.
Yeah. I remember one time he and the
late Gene Krupa had a little drumming school there.
That's the school I went to!
Eighth Avenue, that's the school I went to -- the Krupa, Cozy Cole Drum School.
There couldn't be two nicer guys together.
True; two sweethearts together, both of them.
